purpose: Rolling accuracy audit for the Northwest Kansas sell-buy agent. Every buy/sell/hold call is logged here when it is made, with the price it was made against and the window that settles it. Nothing is graded from memory — tools/ledger-audit.mjs resolves the realized number from the archived market data.

schema.thesis: one line — why, in sell-buy terms

expected.band: [low, high] — optional, the range the call commits to

basis.source: which report the call was priced against
basis.value: the number the call was made against

market.weight: Colby weight label, e.g. '400-599#', or null

schema.outcome: null until the window closes; then the resolved realized figure
schema.assessment: null until graded; then { verdict: accurate|partial|inaccurate, rootCause, gradedOn }
